alerts.title: Khardung La Pass Temporarily Closed
alerts.message: Heavy snowfall has led to temporary closure of Khardung La Pass. Expected to reopen in 48-72 hours.
alerts.historicalPattern: Frequent closures Oct-Mar due to snow

generalRisks.limitedMedical: Medical facilities scarce in remote areas

alerts.title: Heavy Rainfall Expected
alerts.message: IMD predicts heavy to very heavy rainfall in Kerala. Landslide risk in hilly areas. Avoid trekking and outdoor activities.
alerts.historicalPattern: Heavy rains June-September, landslides in Western Ghats

generalRisks.flooding: Low-lying coastal areas prone to flooding during monsoon

alerts.title: Char Dham Yatra Route Disruption
alerts.message: Recent landslides reported on Rishikesh-Badrinath highway. BRO working on restoration. Check road status before travel.

generalRisks.flashFloods: Risk near rivers during heavy rainfall

generalRisks.sandstorms: Occasional dust storms in desert regions

alerts.title: Snowfall Expected in Upper Regions
alerts.message: Rohtang Pass and Spiti Valley expecting fresh snowfall. Carry chains for vehicles. Check with local authorities before travel.
alerts.historicalPattern: Early snow possible in high-altitude areas from September

generalRisks.strongCurrents: Beach safety - check for red flags before swimming

alerts.title: Protected Area Permit Required
alerts.message: Travel to North Sikkim (Gurudongmar Lake, Yumthang Valley) requires Protected Area Permit. Apply 15 days in advance.
alerts.historicalPattern: Permit requirement year-round due to proximity to international border

generalRisks.landslides: Monsoon landslides common on mountain roads

generalRisks.marineLife: Jellyfish and sea urchins - follow lifeguard instructions

alerts.title: High Water Levels in Ganges
alerts.message: River rafting operations temporarily suspended due to high water flow after upstream rainfall. Expected to resume in 2-3 days.
alerts.historicalPattern: River levels fluctuate during monsoon; rafting suspended when flow exceeds safety limits

generalRisks.altitudeSickness: Risk if ascending too quickly to Rohtang/Spiti
